description: Get a synthesized profile for a BSV address: primary display_name, total posts/replies, first/last seen timestamps, and the apps + channels the address has been active on. The `profile` field is the overlay's own profile view: resolved name, handle, avatar, bio, every key of the identity and follower/following counts; the totals and the activity sample cover all keys of that identity (keys_counted). Also flags whether the address is a known custodial relay (treechat.io, etc).

address.description: BSV address to profile (a public key or @handle also works).

name: peck_profile
